statement: The deontic gauge group D4 was DISCOVERED IN DATA ('found by testing every transformation against thousands of moral scenarios').
scope: As asserted in the methodology chapter (§17.0.2) and the objective/governed table (§17.0.3).

evidence.note: CONTRADICTED by the book's own registry, which grades D4 a Conditional Theorem from Axioms A1-A5, and by Appendix E which states the D4 empirical test HAS NOT BEEN RUN (line 41711). The measured 82-87% correlative symmetry supports the two involutions (the Klein-four core V4); the quarter-turn generator that promotes V4 to D4 is nowhere measured.

history.event: SUSPENDED on conversion: asserts as measured what the corpus's own registry grades as conditional and untested. Resolve by (a) withdrawing the discovered-in-data wording, or (b) registering the quarter-turn measurement prospectively.

Resolved as path (a), the wording withdrawn. Owner decision 2026-10-03: D4 is obsolete. The two demonstrated operations generate V4 (erisml-lib formal/HohfeldV4.lean, machine-checked); the quarter-turn is not generated, has never been demonstrated, and the quarter-turn hunt (erisml-lib docs/papers/quarter-turn-hunt) did not find it.
